purpose: Stage and independently review only canonical Local Mistral conversion-root directory authority as an inert pinned directory descriptor.
requiredInvariants: This PR remains inert: it does not activate Local Mistral workflow routing, invoke a model, publish provider status, or change product/API/database/RBAC/registration/cabinet behavior.
Input authority contains exactly exactMainSha, workflowRunId, workflowRunAttempt and conversionRoot; exactMainSha is lowercase SHA-40 and run/attempt are positive integers.
conversionRoot must exactly equal /srv/tai-models/conversion-runs/{exactMainSha}/{workflowRunId}-{workflowRunAttempt}; no caller-selected alternate path is accepted.
Traversal starts from the kernel root directory and opens only the fixed components srv, tai-models, conversion-runs followed by the validated exact-main and canonical run-attempt components.
Every component is opened relative to the already-pinned parent with Linux openat2 using O_PATH|O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC and RESOLVE_BENEATH|RESOLVE_NO_MAGICLINKS|RESOLVE_NO_SYMLINKS.
The root anchor and every opened component must fstat as a directory owned by uid 0 with no group/world write bits; any open, type, ownership or mode mismatch fails closed.
A successful result exposes only the still-open final directory FD plus exact main/run/attempt and stable device/inode identity; file content authority is not established here.

The returned final directory descriptor remains pinned after all ancestor descriptors are closed; later file-identity binding must operate relative to this descriptor and must not reconstruct the pathname.
Local Qwen remains the independent reviewer for this future Local Mistral authority change.
REG.RU remains production authority, mandatory SaaS/API keys remain none and new recurring cost remains 0 RUB.
